literal: On the renwu day Tuyuhun, Goryeo, Dangchang, and Dengzhi states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renwu day Tuyuhun, Goryeo, Dangchang, and Dengzhi states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengyin: the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengyin day, the court visited Yonggu Tomb.

literal: That month the Bright Hall and Grand Temple were completed.
idiomatic: That month the Bright Hall and Grand Temple were completed.

literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: the spirit tablets of the seven temples were moved to the new temple.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingmao day, the spirit tablets of the seven temples were moved to the new temple.

literal: On the yihai day official ranks were greatly fixed.
idiomatic: On the yihai day official ranks were greatly fixed.

literal: On the wuyin day all governors and magistrates were examined.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day all governors and magistrates were examined.

literal: An edict named Acting Outer Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Li Biao and Acting Outer Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Jiang Shaoyou envoys to Xiao Ze.
idiomatic: An edict named Li Biao, acting outer palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Jiang Shaoyou, acting outer palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoys to Xiao Ze.

literal: On the bingxu day the minor new-year congratulations were first abolished.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day the minor new-year congratulations were first abolished.

literal: On the dinghai day an edict stated that those among the two-thousand-shi whose examination was top-top were given acting fourth-rank general and presented one yellow horse;
idiomatic: On the dinghai day an edict stated that those among the two-thousand-shi whose examination was top-top were given acting fourth-rank general and presented one yellow horse;

literal: those top-middle, fifth-rank general;
idiomatic: those top-middle, fifth-rank general;

literal: those top-bottom, one suit of clothing.
idiomatic: those top-bottom, one suit of clothing.

literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: the altar of soil and grain was moved to the west inside the inner city.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renchen day, the altar of soil and grain was moved to the west inside the inner city.

literal: On the guisi day robes and caps were distributed to inspectors and below.
idiomatic: On the guisi day robes and caps were distributed to inspectors and below.

literal: Prince of Anding Xiu was made Grand Tutor; Prince of Qi commandery Jian was made Grand Protector.
idiomatic: Xiu, Prince of Anding, was made grand tutor; Jian, Prince of Qi commandery, was made grand protector.

literal: The Emperor performed mourning for King Lian of Goryeo at the eastern palace traveling lodge.
idiomatic: The emperor performed mourning for King Lian of Goryeo at the eastern palace traveling lodge.

literal: On the jiyou day the imperial carriage welcomed spring at the eastern suburb.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day the court welcomed spring at the eastern suburb.

literal: On the xinhai day an edict ordered selection of music officers.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day an edict ordered selection of music officers.

literal: Sixteenth year, spring, first month, day wuwu new moon: the Emperor feasted the assembled ministers at Taihua Hall.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on the wuwu day, the new moon, the emperor feasted the assembled ministers at Taihua Hall.

literal: The Emperor first performed the bell ceremony for princes and dukes; the bells were hung but not played.
idiomatic: The emperor first performed the bell ceremony for princes and dukes; the bells were hung but not played.

literal: On the jiwei day he performed ancestral sacrifice to Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, in the Bright Hall, pairing him with the Supreme Lord.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day he performed ancestral sacrifice to Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, in the Bright Hall, pairing him with the Supreme Lord.

literal: Thereupon he ascended the Spirit Terrace to observe cloud signs;
idiomatic: Thereupon he ascended the Spirit Terrace to observe cloud signs;

literal: descending, he dwelt in the left apartment of Green Yang and distributed government affairs.
idiomatic: descending, he dwelt in the left apartment of Green Yang and distributed government affairs.

literal: Each new moon this was made the constant practice.
idiomatic: Each new moon this was made the constant practice.

literal: On the xinyou day the Grand Founder was first paired at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day the Grand Founder was first paired at the southern suburb.

literal: On the renxu day an edict fixed the dynastic succession: water succeeds metal.
idiomatic: On the renxu day an edict fixed the dynastic succession: water succeeds metal.

literal: On the jiazi day an edict abolished the ancestral libation.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day an edict abolished the ancestral libation.

literal: Doubtful yichou day: it was decreed that all distant lines not descendants of the Grand Founder and those of other surnames made kings were all reduced to dukes, dukes to marquises, marquises to earls, viscounts and barons remaining as before—all removed from general's titles.
idiomatic: On the doubtful yichou day it was decreed that all distant lines not descendants of the Grand Founder and those of other surnames made kings were all reduced to dukes, dukes to marquises, marquises to earls, viscounts and barons remaining as before—all removed from general's titles.

literal: On the wuchen day the Emperor attended at Siyi Hall and examined eminent scholars and filial candidates.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day the emperor attended at Siyi Hall and examined eminent scholars and filial candidates.

literal: On the bingzi day sacrifice in the temple with the first month of each season was first instituted.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day sacrifice in the temple with the first month of each season was first instituted.

literal: Second month, day wuzi: the Emperor moved his residence to Yongle Palace.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuzi day, the emperor moved his residence to Yongle Palace.

literal: On the gengyin day Taihua Hall was demolished and construction of Taiji was begun.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day Taihua Hall was demolished and construction of Taiji was begun.

literal: On the xinmao day the Cold Food festival feast was abolished.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day the Cold Food festival feast was abolished.

literal: On the renchen day he visited the northern ministry compound, toured all the ministries, toured the capital, and heard wrongful lawsuits.
idiomatic: On the renchen day he visited the northern ministry compound, toured all the ministries, toured the capital, and heard wrongful lawsuits.

literal: On the jiawu day he first paid court to the sun at the eastern suburb; thereafter it was made constant.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day he first paid court to the sun at the eastern suburb; thereafter it was made constant.

literal: On the dingyou day an edict ordered sacrifice to Tang Yao at Pingyang, Yu Shun at Guangning, Yu of Xia at Anyi, and King Wen of Zhou at Luoyang.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict ordered sacrifice to Tang Yao at Pingyang, Yu Shun at Guangning, Yu of Xia at Anyi, and King Wen of Zhou at Luoyang.

idiomatic: [5] On the dingwei day the posthumous title of Confucius was changed to Ni Father, Sage of Letters, and the title was announced at the Confucian temple.

literal: Third month, day dingmao: toured the capital.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingmao day, he toured the capital.

literal: On the guiyou day miscellaneous matters of suburban heaven sacrifice at the western suburb were reduced.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day miscellaneous matters of suburban heaven sacrifice at the western suburb were reduced.

literal: On the yihai day the imperial carriage first welcomed qi at the southern suburb; from this it was constant.
idiomatic: On the yihai day the court first welcomed qi at the southern suburb; from this it was constant.

literal: On the xinsi day Sun Yun, grandson of King Lian of Goryeo, was made king of that state.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day Sun Yun, grandson of King Lian of Goryeo, was made king of that state.

literal: Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month Goryeo and the state of Dengzhi each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That month Goryeo and the state of Dengzhi each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth month, day dinghai new moon: the new statutes and ordinances were promulgated; a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the dinghai day, the new moon, the new statutes and ordinances were promulgated and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On the guisi day the state of Qiqie sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the guisi day the state of Qiqie sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jiayin day he visited the Imperial Clan School and personally questioned the erudites on the classics' meaning.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day he visited the Imperial Clan School and personally questioned the erudites on the classics' meaning.

literal: Fifth month, day guimao: an edict assembled the ministers at Imperial Trust Hall to revise statute articles and limits on exile and penal servitude; the Emperor personally decided.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guimao day, an edict assembled the ministers at Imperial Trust Hall to revise statute articles and limits on exile and penal servitude; the emperor personally decided.

literal: Sixth month, day jichou: the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jiachen day an edict said: "To attend to agriculture and value grain is what royal government puts first;
idiomatic: On the jiachen day an edict said, "To attend to agriculture and value grain is what royal government puts first;

literal: to encourage and lead field work is the ruler's constant duty.
idiomatic: to encourage and lead field work is the ruler's constant duty.

literal: Now the four seasons are in proper order and timely rain is abundant; we should use Heaven's division of land and exert all strength on the eastern acres.
idiomatic: Now the four seasons are in proper order and timely rain is abundant; we should use Heaven's division of land and exert all strength on the eastern acres.

literal: Yet among the people of the capital many live by wandering and eating; without added supervision and encouragement, some weed and hoe out of season.
idiomatic: Yet among the people of the capital many live by wandering and eating; without added supervision and encouragement, some weed and hoe out of season.

literal: Let clear envoys be sent to inspect diligence and laziness and report."
idiomatic: Let clear envoys be sent to inspect diligence and laziness and report."

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengshen: the heir of Tuyuhun Helutou came to court.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengshen day, the heir of Tuyuhun Helutou came to court.

literal: On the renxu day an edict said: "The king establishes offices and divides duties, drapes his arms and assigns completion, shakes the net and raises the cord—the multitude of eyes then has order.
idiomatic: On the renxu day an edict said, "The king establishes offices and divides duties, drapes his arms and assigns completion, shakes the net and raises the cord—the multitude of eyes then has order.

literal: Our virtue falls short of knowing men—how can we discern at a single glance? We merely fail the ruler's meaning of entrusting appointment.
idiomatic: Our virtue falls short of knowing men—how can we discern at a single glance? We merely fail the ruler's meaning of entrusting appointment.

literal: From now on at each selection, every third month, the original office together with the Ministry of Personnel shall examine and choose.
idiomatic: From now on at each selection, every third month, the original office together with the Ministry of Personnel shall examine and choose.

literal: " On the jiaxu day an edict named Acting Outer Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Song Bian and Acting Outer Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Fang Liang envoys to Xiao Ze.
idiomatic: " On the jiaxu day an edict named Song Bian, acting outer palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Fang Liang, acting outer palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoys to Xiao Ze.

literal: Eighth month, day gengyin: the imperial carriage first performed evening moon rites at the western suburb; thereafter it was constant.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, the court first performed evening moon rites at the western suburb; thereafter it was constant.

literal: On the xinmao day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the yiwei day an edict ordered Prince of Yangping Yi and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Rui to supervise twelve generals and seventy thousand cavalry on a northern campaign against the Rouran.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict ordered Yi, Prince of Yangping, and Lu Rui, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to supervise twelve generals and seventy thousand cavalry on a northern campaign against the Rouran.

literal: On the bingwu day King Chengcheng of Dangchang Liang Micheng came to court.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day Liang Micheng, king Chengcheng of Dangchang, came to court.

literal: Minister of Works Wei Yuan yielded his post on account of age.
idiomatic: Wei Yuan, minister of works, yielded his post on account of age.

literal: On the jiyou day Wei Yuan was made Senior Elder; You Minggen was made Junior Elder.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day Wei Yuan was made senior elder; You Minggen was made junior elder.

literal: Also the state elder and common elder were supported.
idiomatic: Also the state elder and common elder were supported.

literal: The great archery rite was about to be performed; rain fell and it could not be completed.
idiomatic: The great archery rite was about to be performed; rain fell and it could not be completed.

literal: On the guichou day an edict said: "The way of wen and wu has from antiquity proceeded together; the application of authority and blessing must also rely on each other.
idiomatic: On the guichou day an edict said, "The way of wen and wu has from antiquity proceeded together; the application of authority and blessing must also rely on each other.

literal: Thus the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors at utmost benevolence still had campaigns of conquest;
idiomatic: Thus the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors at utmost benevolence still had campaigns of conquest;

literal: Xia and Yin at bright sagacity did not abandon the march of arms and armor.
idiomatic: Xia and Yin at bright sagacity did not abandon the march of arms and armor.

literal: Thus though all under Heaven is at peace, to forget war is perilous; not to teach the people war may be called abandoning them.
idiomatic: Thus though all under Heaven is at peace, to forget war is perilous; not to teach the people war may be called abandoning them.

literal: Therefore Zhou established the office of Minister of War; Han set the post of general—all to assist wen and strengthen wu, awe and order the four quarters.
idiomatic: Therefore Zhou established the office of Minister of War; Han set the post of general—all to assist wen and strengthen wu, awe and order the four quarters.

literal: Our state though it honors wen to embrace the nine domains and repairs wu to settle the eight wilds, yet in the method of practicing wu there is still what is not complete.
idiomatic: Our state though it honors wen to embrace the nine domains and repairs wu to settle the eight wilds, yet in the method of practicing wu there is still what is not complete.

literal: Now instruction in wen has its canon; instruction in wu lacks form.
idiomatic: Now instruction in wen has its canon; instruction in wu lacks form.

literal: Before the horse archery, let the drill-wu form be performed first; let the relevant offices prepare the field and embankments in advance.
idiomatic: Before the horse archery, let the drill-wu form be performed first; let the relevant offices prepare the field and embankments in advance.

literal: The array rites and the numbers of the five armies await a later edict separately.
idiomatic: The array rites and the numbers of the five armies await a later edict separately.

literal: " Ninth month, day jiayin new moon: the zhao and mu were fully ordered in the Bright Hall; Empress Dowager Wenming was sacrificed in the Dark Chamber.
idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on the jiayin day, the new moon, the zhao and mu were fully ordered in the Bright Hall; Empress Dowager Wenming was sacrificed in the Dark Chamber.

literal: On the xinwei day, because it was the Zhou anniversary of Grand Empress Dowager Wenming, the Emperor wept at the left of the tomb, abstained from food for two days, and wept without ceasing.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, because it was the Zhou anniversary of Grand Empress Dowager Wenming, the emperor wept at the left of the tomb, abstained from food for two days, and wept without ceasing.

literal: On the xinsi day King Jishi of Wuxing Yang Jishi came to court.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day Yang Jishi, king Jishi of Wuxing, came to court.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day yiyou: the state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiyou day, the state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jihai day Grand Tutor, Prince of Anding Xiu was made Grand Marshal; Special Advanced Feng Dan was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On the jihai day Xiu, grand tutor and Prince of Anding, was made grand marshal; Feng Dan, special advanced, was made minister of works.

literal: On the jiachen day an edict ordered meritorious ministers paired in offerings at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day an edict ordered meritorious ministers paired in offerings at the Grand Temple.

literal: On the bingwu day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the gengxu day Taiji Hall was completed; the assembled ministers were given a great feast.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day Taiji Hall was completed; the assembled ministers were given a great feast.

literal: Eleventh month, day yimao: following antiquity's six inner chambers, three chambers were provisionally instituted—Anchang Hall as inner chamber, Imperial Trust Hall as middle chamber, and the four lower, doubtful, as outer chamber.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, following antiquity's six inner chambers, three chambers were provisionally instituted—Anchang Hall as inner chamber, Imperial Trust Hall as middle chamber, and the four lower, doubtful, as outer chamber.

literal: [6] Twelfth month: the aged of the capital were given dove staffs.
idiomatic: [6] In the twelfth month the aged of the capital were given dove staffs.

literal: That month Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, day renzi new moon: the Emperor feasted the hundred officials at Taiji Hall.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventeenth year, on the renzi day, the new moon, the emperor feasted the hundred officials at Taiji Hall.

literal: On the yichou day an edict said: "To gallop in haste to court audience is the minister's constant form;
idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict said, "To gallop in haste to court audience is the minister's constant form;

literal: to bestow horses and grant chariots is the ruler's constant favor.
idiomatic: to bestow horses and grant chariots is the ruler's constant favor.

literal: Now the frontier lords and barbarian heirs all reverently gather at the Elephant Tower, hurrying to the Purple Court.
idiomatic: Now the frontier lords and barbarian heirs all reverently gather at the Elephant Tower, hurrying to the Purple Court.

literal: When tribute and feasting are complete, they speak of returning without delay.
idiomatic: When tribute and feasting are complete, they speak of returning without delay.

literal: Each may according to rank be given chariots, banners, clothing, and horses—let the grant be thick and generous.
idiomatic: Each may according to rank be given chariots, banners, clothing, and horses—let the grant be thick and generous.

literal: Wuxing and Dangchang are each given one thousand bolts of brocade and silk floss;
idiomatic: Wuxing and Dangchang are each given one thousand bolts of brocade and silk floss;

literal: the heir of Tuyuhun, eight hundred;
idiomatic: the heir of Tuyuhun, eight hundred;

literal: the heir of Dengzhi, though he came to the capital by circumstance, should also be rewarded—three hundred may be granted.
idiomatic: the heir of Dengzhi, though he came to the capital by circumstance, should also be rewarded—three hundred may be granted.

literal: Differences in order of command all follow separate documents.
idiomatic: Differences in order of command all follow separate documents.

literal: An edict named Acting Outer Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Chengshu envoy to Xiao Ze.
idiomatic: An edict named Liu Chengshu, acting outer palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Xiao Ze.

literal: [7] On the yihai day the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: [7] On the yihai day the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the bingzi day Fuliancou of Tuyuhun was made king of that state.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day Fuliancou of Tuyuhun was made king of that state.

literal: On the gengchen day Grand Marshal, Prince of Anding Xiu, and Grand Protector, Prince of Qi commandery Jian were exempted from new-moon and full-moon court.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day Xiu, grand marshal and Prince of Anding, and Jian, grand protector and Prince of Qi commandery, were exempted from new-moon and full-moon court.

literal: Second month, day yiyou: an edict granted differing rewards to officials who debated statutes and ordinances.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiyou day, an edict granted differing rewards to officials who debated statutes and ordinances.
